skill: 副词修饰范围 + straight up
q: When reporters asked why the product launch had been delayed, the engineer was surprisingly straight up: “We underestimated the testing time.” Her manner was best described as:

exp.trans: 记者问产品为什么延期发布时，这位工程师出人意料地直截了当：“我们低估了测试所需的时间。”她的表达方式最适合形容为坦率。
exp.structure: 主句：the engineer（主语）+ was（系动词）+ surprisingly straight up（表语）。surprisingly修饰straight up，回答“出人意料地怎么样”。冒号后的直接引语具体证明她没有遮掩原因。
exp.other: product launch 产品发布；delay 推迟；underestimate 低估；testing time 测试时间。
exp.meaning: straight up在这里表示坦率、直截了当；surprisingly只表示这种坦率令人意外，不等于“冲动”。
exp.rest: impulsive表示冲动、未经充分考虑就行动，通常描述decision/action；ceremonial表示仪式性的；hostile表示敌对的。三者都不能由“直接承认低估测试时间”推出。

target: come right out and say / frank
q: Instead of giving a vague excuse for the exhibition's cancellation, the curator came right out and said that ticket sales had been too low. This response was:

exp.trans: 这位策展人没有用含糊的借口解释展览取消，而是直接说票卖得太少了。这种回应是坦率的。
exp.structure: Instead of giving...是介词短语作对比背景。主干：the curator（主语）+ came right out and said（谓语）+ that从句（宾语）。that ticket sales had been too low说明她直接说出的真实原因。
exp.other: vague excuse 含糊的借口；curator 策展人；cancellation 取消；ticket sales 票房/售票量。
exp.meaning: come right out and say = 直截了当地说；语气上对应frank，而不是回避。
exp.rest: evasive表示闪烁其词、回避，和instead of a vague excuse相反；impulsive强调冲动行为；indifferent表示冷漠、不在意，原句没有这种态度。

target: post=职位 / aspiration / 文本证据
skill: 熟词生义 + 证据约束
q: After five years as a sous-chef, Lena began applying for head-chef posts because she wanted to run a kitchen of her own. What is directly supported by the sentence?
o: She was pursuing a new career goal.
She disliked everyone in her current kitchen.
She had already been offered a head-chef job.

exp.trans: 做了五年副厨师长后，Lena开始申请主厨职位，因为她想独立管理一个厨房。句子直接支持：她正在追求新的职业目标。
exp.structure: 主句：Lena（主语）+ began applying（谓语）+ for head-chef posts。because从句给出原因：she wanted to run a kitchen of her own。原因明确指向职业角色和职责，而非薪酬。
exp.other: sous-chef 副厨师长；head-chef post 主厨职位；apply for 申请；run a kitchen 管理厨房。
exp.meaning: post在这里是职位；“想独立管理厨房”是职业抱负/目标。不能因为职位更高就擅自补出“工资更高”。
exp.rest: higher salary在现实中可能成立，但原句没有salary/pay等证据；disliked everyone完全无依据；began applying只表示开始申请，不等于已经拿到offer。

target: post=职位 / 不用常识补因果
q: Marco said he was looking for an editor-in-chief post because he wanted final responsibility for a magazine's content. Which explanation stays closest to the text?
o: He mainly wanted better financial status.
He wanted a different level of professional responsibility.
He had been dismissed from his current job.
He was trying to avoid all management work.

exp.trans: Marco说他正在寻找总编辑职位，因为他想对一本杂志的内容承担最终责任。最贴近原文的是：他想获得不同层级的职业责任。
exp.structure: 主句：Marco + said + 宾语从句。宾语从句中he was looking for an editor-in-chief post；because从句he wanted final responsibility...解释求职动机。
exp.other: editor-in-chief 总编辑；final responsibility 最终责任；content 内容；professional responsibility 职业职责。
exp.meaning: 原文证据链是post → responsibility，而不是post → money。做阅读题必须沿文本明说的因果走。
exp.rest: financial status没有文本证据；dismissed没有被解雇信息；avoid management与想承担最终责任正相反。

q: A rival laboratory offered unusually generous contracts in an attempt to ___ two senior researchers from our team.

exp.trans: 一家竞争实验室开出异常优厚的合同，试图从我们团队挖走两名资深研究员。
exp.structure: 主干：A rival laboratory（主语）+ offered（谓语）+ contracts（宾语）。in an attempt to poach...表示目的；poach的宾语是two senior researchers，from our team说明从哪里挖走。
exp.other: rival competitor 竞争对手；generous contract 优厚合同；senior researcher 资深研究员；in an attempt to 试图。
exp.meaning: 商业/招聘语境中poach sb from... = 从别的组织挖人、挖角。
exp.rest: attend to = 处理/照料；guard against = 防范；approve of = 赞成。它们都不表达“用条件把别人的人才招走”。

q: The museum hired a specialist recruiter to ___ candidates with experience in restoring ancient textiles. Which phrase best fits?

exp.trans: 博物馆聘请了一名专业招聘人员，去物色有古代纺织品修复经验的候选人。
exp.structure: 主干：The museum + hired + a specialist recruiter。to hunt for candidates是不定式作目的状语；with experience...修饰candidates。
exp.other: specialist recruiter 专业招聘人员；candidate 候选人；restore 修复；ancient textiles 古代纺织品。
exp.meaning: hunt for = 寻找、搜寻、物色。它强调寻找对象；poach则进一步强调从别处把人挖走。
exp.rest: attend to = 处理/照料，常见attend to a customer/problem；guard against = 防范；approve of = 赞成。均不表示招聘人员寻找候选人。

q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: climb才是“攀爬”；公开批评是criticize openly；快速修改是revise quickly。这里语境是明知规则已简化仍不愿放弃旧做法。

q: The child ___ to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The child + clung to + his father's arm。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed to his father's arm不符合“抓住手臂”的语义；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed over在第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

target: 传统观念 ≠ 实际行为事实
q: A report says: “For years, the conventional wisdom was that renting a small office was safer than buying one.” Which statement is justified?
o: Every small business rented its office for years.
There was a widespread belief that renting was safer.
Buying an office was legally forbidden.
Businesses that bought offices always failed.

exp.trans: 报告说：“多年来，传统观念认为租一间小办公室比买一间更安全。”能够成立的是：曾经存在一种广泛观念，认为租赁更安全。
exp.structure: 主干：the conventional wisdom（主语）+ was（系动词）+ that从句（表语）。that从句说明“观念的内容”，不是统计所有企业实际做了什么。
exp.other: conventional wisdom 传统看法/普遍观念；rent 租；buy 购买；widespread 广泛的。
exp.meaning: belief/rule/considered safer描述的是人们怎么想，不能直接推成“所有人过去都这么做”。
exp.rest: Every把范围扩大成全部企业；legally forbidden把“认为不安全”偷换成法律禁止；always failed把风险判断偷换成必然失败，都是证据过头。

target: belief / rule / considered ≠ 行为事实
q: The article states: “The old rule of thumb was that athletes should avoid strength training during the season.” What can you safely conclude?
o: No athlete ever lifted weights during the season.
Coaches once commonly advised against in-season strength training.
Strength training was banned by every sports federation.
Athletes who trained during the season were always injured.

exp.trans: 文章说：“过去的经验法则认为，运动员赛季期间应避免力量训练。”安全的结论是：教练界过去普遍有这种建议。
exp.structure: 主干：The old rule of thumb + was + that从句。that athletes should avoid...说明规则/建议内容。should表达规范性判断，而不是历史行为统计。
exp.other: rule of thumb 经验法则；athlete 运动员；strength training 力量训练；in-season 赛季期间的。
exp.meaning: 规范、建议和传统观念只能支持“有人这样主张/建议”，不能自动推出所有人都遵守。
exp.rest: No athlete ever和every federation都是绝对化扩大；always injured把建议背后的风险偷换成必然结果。

target: 标题具体性 / 抓反复强调的特殊现象
q: 短文：越来越多研究团队会在同行评审完成前先发布预印本。作者反复讨论这样做的速度优势、误读风险，以及“先公开、后评审”正在改变学术传播节奏。哪个标题最贴切？

exp.trans: 短文核心是：越来越多团队在同行评审完成之前先公开预印本，并讨论这种“先公开、后评审”的新节奏。
exp.structure: 题干给了三类信息：现象（先发预印本）、利弊（速度/误读风险）、趋势（改变传播节奏）。标题应抓住反复出现的特殊条件，而不是只抓大类话题science/research。
exp.other: preprint 预印本；peer review 同行评审；misreading 误读；academic communication 学术传播。
exp.meaning: 好标题通常覆盖全文最特殊、反复出现的现象。Publishing Before Peer Review直接命中“评审前发布”。
exp.rest: Science Is Changing过于宽泛；The Only Future含Only，原文只说越来越多，不是唯一道路；Why Research Is Difficult把主题偷换成研究困难。

target: 主旨标题 / 特殊限定条件
q: 短文：一些游客现在会在签证获批前就购买可退改机票。文章重点讨论这种“先订票、后等签证”的风险和好处。哪个标题最好？
o: The Only Smart Way to Travel

exp.trans: 短文关注的是一种具体行为：在签证批准之前先订可退改机票，并讨论其风险与好处。
exp.structure: 主旨由反复出现的时间关系“before approval”限定。标题需要既覆盖行为，又保留这个特殊条件。
exp.other: visa approval 签证获批；refundable 可退款的；risk 风险；benefit 好处。
exp.meaning: Booking Before Approval准确概括特殊现象；不是只说“旅游”，也不夸大成唯一正确方式。
exp.rest: Travel in the Modern World范围太大；The Only Smart Way含绝对化Only，原文只说“一些游客”；Why Visas Should Disappear引入原文没有的政策主张。

target: have sth lined up / position lined up
q: Nora resigned from her apartment lease only after she had another place lined up for the following month. Here, had another place lined up means:
o: 把另一个地方排成一条线
已经事先安排好了另一个住处
正在地图上寻找另一个地方

exp.trans: Nora只有在已经提前安排好下个月的新住处之后，才终止了原来的租约。
exp.structure: 主句：Nora + resigned from/ended her lease（语义上是结束租约）。only after引导时间条件；she had another place lined up表示那时新住处已经提前落实。
exp.other: lease 租约；following month 下个月；resign/leave 退出；place 住处。
exp.meaning: have sth lined up = 已经预先安排好、落实好某事。position/job lined up就是已经找好下一份职位/工作。
exp.rest: line up确实可表示排队/排成一列，但have a place lined up在此是安排义；寻找还未完成不能解释had...lined up；取消则与“先有新住处再退旧租约”的逻辑相反。

q: Before graduating, Priya already had a summer internship lined up at a design studio. This means:
o: She had already secured the internship in advance.
She was still casually browsing internship ads.
The studio had rejected her application.
She planned to arrange desks in a line.

exp.trans: 毕业前，Priya已经提前落实了一份在设计工作室的暑期实习。
exp.structure: 主干：Priya + had + a summer internship lined up。before graduating是时间状语。过去完成/拥有结构强调在毕业这一时间点之前，实习已经安排妥当。
exp.other: graduate 毕业；internship 实习；design studio 设计工作室；secure 获得、落实。
exp.meaning: have sth lined up = 提前安排好/确定好。与still browsing这种“还在找”相反。
exp.rest: still browsing说明尚未落实；rejected表示被拒绝；arrange desks in a line利用line的字面义制造干扰，但与internship语境无关。

target: only / always / all 绝对词陷阱
q: 原文只说：“An increasing number of neighborhood cafés are adding late-night hours.” 哪个改写明显过强？
o: More neighborhood cafés are staying open late.
Some cafés are extending their hours.
Late-night opening is becoming more common among neighborhood cafés.
Keeping late-night hours is the only way neighborhood cafés can survive.

exp.trans: 原文只说：越来越多社区咖啡馆增加了深夜营业时段。明显过强的是：深夜营业是社区咖啡馆生存的唯一方式。
exp.structure: 原句核心：An increasing number of...（主语）+ are adding（谓语）+ late-night hours（宾语）。它描述趋势，不提供生存因果，更没有唯一性。
exp.other: an increasing number of 越来越多；extend hours 延长营业时间；common 常见的；survive 生存。
exp.meaning: only / all / always / must等词会把“趋势/部分”升级成“唯一/全部/必然”。没有强证据时通常属于过度推断。
exp.rest: 前三项都保留了趋势或部分范围；第四项不仅加入survive因果，还加入the only way，双重超出原文。

q: A survey found that many users prefer the app's simpler layout. Which conclusion is NOT justified?
o: The simpler layout appeals to many users.
Some users may prefer the new layout.
The survey provides evidence of a preference trend.
Every user prefers the simpler layout.

exp.trans: 一项调查发现，许多用户更喜欢这个应用更简洁的布局。不能成立的结论是：每一位用户都更喜欢它。
exp.structure: 原句：many users（主语）+ prefer（谓语）+ the app's simpler layout（宾语）。many不是all，也不是every。
exp.other: survey 调查；prefer 更喜欢；layout 布局；trend 趋势。
exp.meaning: 阅读推理必须保持量词范围。many可以支持“很多/存在趋势”，不能升级成every。
exp.rest: appeals to many基本同义；Some是比many更弱的存在性陈述；preference trend也与many users一致；Every把范围扩大到全部，证据不足。
